summary: David Morano died in an approximately 200-foot fall on Thunder Pyramid
notes: Merged the opened Real Vail archive account (David Morano, 41, of Dillon; 200-300 ft fall off the ridge south of Pyramid Peak near Thunder Pyramid; companion called from a Maroon Bells-Snowmass wilderness substation ~4:30 pm; MRA recon flight ~90 min later) — its 'Saturday' corroborates the 2011-09-10 (Saturday) date. Meridian detail (run 809): two-person MRA team hoisted via 150-ft helicopter cable; body to T-Lazy Seven Ranch LZ; autopsy scheduled Thursday; survived by wife and 8-year-old child.
